senses.gloss: (I)--a tree peculiar to हरिवर्ष. Br. II. १७. 7.
(II) (क्रतु)--a R. of शाकद्वीप, from the side of the Himalayas. Br. II. १९. ९६; M. १२२. ३२; वा. ४९. ९३; Vi. II. 4. ६५.
(III)--one of the seven oceans; see इक्षुरसोदा। Br. IV. ३१. १८; M. 2. ३४.
(IV)--a R. from the side of the हिमालयस्, in the भारतवर्ष. M. ११४. २२; वा. ४५. ९६.
(V)--a R. joining the नर्मदा; very holy. A bath here makes one lord of a देवगण. M. १९१. ४९-50.
--given by ब्रह्मा to कामेश्वर as a wedding present; also इक्षुधनुस्। Br. IV. १५. १९; १९. २६; १८. 1.
--sugarcane juice for श्राद्ध; one of the eight सौभाग्यम्स्। M. 7. ११ and २६; १५. ३५; ६०. 8; ८५. 6. [page१-183+ ४०]
(I)--a R. On its banks was the hermitage of Kapila. भा. V. १०. 1; Vi. II. १३. ५३.
--one of the seven seas surrounding प्लक्ष- द्वीप. भा. V. 1. ३३; २०. 7; Vi. II. 4, २०.
--a R. of the Mahendra hill. वा. ४५. १०६.

--one of the ten (nine-ब्र्। प्।) sons of Vaiva- svata Manu. Born of his sneezing.
1: भा. VIII. १३. 2; IX. 1. 3 and १२; 2. 2; वा. ६४. २९; ८५. 4; ८८. 9; Vi. IV. 1. 7; Br. II. ३८. ३०; III. ६०. 2 and २०; ६३. 8; M. 9. ३०; ११. ४१.
Father of a hundred sons--विकुक्षि, Nimi, दण्ड and others. २५ of these sons ruled आर्यावर्त, २५, the western territory, three, the middle country and the rest all other provinces. Once in connec- tion with an अष्टक ritual, विकुक्षि was asked to secure some flesh. Accordingly he did. But feeling hungry he partook a part of hare's flesh. When the remainder was presented, the पुरोहित refused to take it on the ground that it was remain- der of that already tasted. विकुक्षि was therefore punished with banishment. It is said that he became a yogin and attained salvation.
2: भा. IX. 6. 4-१०; Vi. IV. 2. १५-18.
A king known for his exemplary pro- tection of his subjects. परीक्षित् compared to him.
3: भा. I. १२. १९.
Promi- nent kings of his line.
4: M. १२. १५-56; वा. ९९. २८०-290.
Knew the power of Hari's योग, and in his line Hari incarnated.
5: भा. II. 7. २३ and ४४; XII. 2. ३७;
Sumitra was the last क्षत्रिय king of this line.
6: Br. III. ७४. २४४; M. २७३. ५३; वा. ९९. २६६ and ४३१.
Originator of the solar race; the genea- logy given down to शन्तायु of the भारत war.
7: M. १२. १५-56.
Heard from वसिष्ठ of Ila's conversion to the other sex in the शर- वण forest and performed अश्वमेध by which Ila was [page१-184+ २७] turned into a किम्पुरुष.
8: M. १२. 1-१५.
Was addressed by the पितृस् in कलाप forest on the effect of offering श्राद्ध at गया.

The line of.
